# X/x: Specification without Exhaustion

## #0 — Capacity and its particular

`X/x` enters as the fourth interior determination, at #3, of the [eight-determination traversal](eight-determinations.md), after reserve/issue and before the personed copula. `X` names determining capacity; `x` the indefinite particular through which it becomes determinate. The [core spine](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) develops its algebraic, psychic and agentic refractions. The [root X/x](../../X-x.md) holds their relation; specification makes the relation between determining capacity and particular performance explicit.

The lower-case variable is indefinite before specification and definite in a particular assignment. This double standing matters: an actual value can be genuine without being the last value the variable can bear.

## #1 — Specify a value

Take the elementary equation `x+2=5` over the real numbers. Subtraction yields `x=3`; within those stated conditions the solution is exact. Change the condition to `x+2=7` and the same variable can take `5`. Nothing in the first solution licensed replacing the capacity for specification with the numeral `3` in every subsequent problem.

This example displays the asymmetry in a narrow algebraic setting. Native `X` is the capacity the notation makes available; it is not a new real-valued unknown secretly added to the equation. The relation `X/x` therefore cannot be reduced by cancelling letters as though it were an ordinary quotient of two assigned scalars.

## #2 — Let recurrence bear variation

A recurring musical figure can remain identifiable through transposition, timing and instrumentation. The occurrence is actual; the capacity for recurrence is encountered through its varied occurrences. A narrative figure likewise becomes particular in a scene while carrying possibilities that the present scene has not enacted. These are distinct modes of the capacity/particular relation, and their local conditions determine what counts as faithful recurrence.

The formal task is to retain both terms: specify the present `x`, and state which relation makes it an occurrence of `X`. Without the first, the capacity remains unworked; without the second, the particular is detached from the field that makes its identity legible.

## #3 — Read the psychic equation in its own register

The core's psychic unit writes `X=x`: Self, determinate ego and the equating operation read as identity-through-difference. It unfolds reserve, consciousness, psychoid threshold, mediated relation, context and recognised wholeness. The context position changes the office of the equation by including the conditions under which it is being solved. Its return loosens the claim that one determinate self-description is the total capacity for selfhood.

Frank's p.69 [Van Eenwyk encounter](../../episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md) follows a symbol from the known into the unknown and back. A familiar image can open possibilities its present interpretation had excluded; the return changes the ego's organisation rather than merely repeating that image. Taylor reads the slash through this movement: a particular `x` returns toward determining capacity `X`, and that capacity can issue in another `x`. The psychological symbol works through feeling, image and changed self-organisation; the native relation makes the particular's return to capacity explicit.

## #4 — Include the conditions of specification

In the agentic refraction, a session is specified through model capacity, context, memory, tools, permissions and a milieu. An account of its particular performance becomes more exact when these constitutive conditions are disclosed. Persona consistency alone cannot establish that disclosure.

The comparison yields an actionable distinction: record a particular result together with the conditions that generated and constrained it, then permit a changed context to produce another result. The achieved performance has the office of a particular `x`; its disclosed model, context and permissions make the capacity and constraints of its specification more legible. The next occurrence can therefore carry a changed condition rather than merely repeat the earlier persona. Inquiry retains both the formed answer and the means through which it became available, so that a successful specification can enter another act without exhausting its determining capacity.

## #5→0 — Restore the capacity after the answer

The result is a specification that can return. `x=3` remains the answer to its equation; a different equation can be posed. A musical occurrence remains played; its form can recur otherwise. A self-description remains situated; its speaker is not used up by it. The native return carries this asymmetry through AM/IS and ∞/dx toward `1/0`.

Determining capacity and its changed particular return to [Primordial Symbolon and Its Eight Determinations](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md), [Individuation / Recognition](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md), and [§3 · #5→0 — The Arche-Topos](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/30-s3-p5-arche-topos.md). [Complex orientation](complex-orientation.md) provides a precise mathematical construction for variation with an invariant relation; it has its own hypotheses and does not replace this native specification operation.
